In the old days, there was a monster. It was Nian. Everyone was afraid of it.

Spring was coming. Nian went to a village at night. It ate many animals.

Long long ago, a little boy was walking in a forest. He saw an old tree. The tree said to the boy, "I am a magic tree. Say the magic words and you will see."

The boy tried many words, but they didn't work. Then the boy said, "Please, dear tree!" A door opened in the tree! But it was dark inside.

The tree said, "Say the magic words, please." Then the boy said, "Thank you!" With this, it turned bright inside the tree and the boy saw a lot of toys.

After that, "please" and "thank you" became the magic words. Do you often say them?
